summary: Issue #177: three keywords with real mechanisms (Expendable -- mandatory Fate-deck draw on any real destroy, not a plain discard; Destined -- mandatory draw on entering play via any existing entry path; Kharmic -- a repeatable pay-2-Gold-and-discard action, refilling a Dynasty province face up or drawing an extra Fate card), plus Fudo/Fallen added to #144's pure-conditional keyword list. Follow-up spec in the same issue: a general passive Attack-strength defense modifier (CardDefinition.AttackDefenseKind/Amount/Scope, Self/Wielder/Unit), a new 'any Personality enters play' Reaction trigger (Singh Remnants attaching itself from hand or a discard pile, following Equip's own restrictions), and the Invest mechanism (Clay Kshatriya, reusing the existing own-enters-play Reaction window since it's genuinely optional). Final follow-up: generalized the two ad hoc Reaction-availability checks (AnyAttackReactionAvailable, AnyPersonalityEntryReactionAvailable) into two explicitly-named, Trigger-parameterized primitives (AnyInPlayReactionAvailable, AnyOutOfPlayReactionAvailable) for future cards (Legion of the Bat, Effortless Counterattack) to reuse directly -- a pure refactor, zero behavior change, confirmed by the full suite passing unchanged. Follower Wave 4 wires the three real cards these primitives were built for (Destrier, Singh Remnants, Clay Kshatriya). Shared-file note: touches L5R.Core (rules engine primitives), its test suite, content/published/follower-wave-4.json plus -sources.json, a new tools/content/package_follower_wave_4.py, and docs/ROADMAP.md/docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx (including a new Blocker column, populated for all 77 Follower-Wave-3-deferred cards) -- a single rules-lane change; no UI/client files touched.
validation: New KeywordMechanics test (Expendable/Destined/Kharmic/Invest) and PassiveAttackDefenseAndEntryWatch test (Self/Unit/Wielder defense scopes, Singh Remnants' attach-on-entry from hand and a discard pile including the Personal Honor Requirement rejection). Full suite: 105/105 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes (13/13 AI, 5/5 server integration, 4/4 client transport integration). docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (170 wired, up from 167; new Blocker column).
remaining: Legion of the Bat and Effortless Counterattack (the two general Reaction-primitive callers named in the spec) are not wired -- each needs its own further not-yet-built piece (an 'after a move resolves' trigger; an 'additional action' mechanic) beyond what's built here. Discard-pile and dead-to-life entry paths for Destined/Singh Remnants are not real engine paths yet -- noted, needs no further change to cover them once built.
